standard: REED Mk2.1 — observe, root-cause, test the strongest explanation, fix the earliest broken layer, verify, regression-protect

items.title: global navigation
items.fix: One registry (src/navigation.js) supplies the top nav, both menus and the mode shelf.

items.title: Play dropdown
items.fix: Carries all seven modes plus How Modes Work, each with its resolved status badge.
items.verification: Browser and e2e: every mode visible, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.

items.title: Fantasy dropdown
items.fix: A first-class top-level pillar with EraClash Fantasy and EraClash Live, each with a real development status.

items.title: mode registry
items.fix: No component defines its own mode list; a test asserts both consumers import the registry and declare none of their own.

items.title: fantasy registry
items.fix: Two destinations with routes, statuses and an explicit statement of how they differ.

items.title: entitlement routing
items.fix: One resolver returns an intent per status; five statuses produce five genuinely different behaviours.
items.verification: A guest clicking Win 82 lands on /membership?feature=win82&required=plus&from=%2Fplay.

items.title: membership destination
items.fix: One route accepting feature, required tier and return path, with no payment processing, price, trial or checkout.

items.title: coming-soon must not impersonate a paid product
items.fix: A mode that is not built routes to its own information page and states it is not part of any membership.

items.title: account state
items.fix: The header reads real account state. The concept's named account and Legend Tier are not hard-coded; a device-local account is described honestly as saved on this device.

items.title: upgrade CTA
items.fix: The account menu offers Explore membership, routed through the single destination.

items.title: arena shell
items.fix: A two-column command centre with a sticky, internally scrolling dock that stacks below 1180px.
items.verification: Measured in a browser: two columns, position sticky, no page overflow.

items.title: draft control rail and roll progression
items.fix: A three-part roll strip driven entirely by server state, so it cannot invent a roll or count the empty board as Roll 1.

items.title: Gold versus Blue presentation
items.fix: Both boards in one arena with labels, borders and accents, so the sides never depend on colour alone.
items.defectFound: Ten cards sharing a row broke player names mid-word; cards now have a readable minimum width and wrap instead of shrinking.

items.title: Era Reveal and persistence
items.fix: The Phase 8B era banner is carried by the arena shell and repeated compactly in the dock, so the era is present from the reveal through the postgame.

items.title: Coach Draft in the arena
items.fix: The Phase 8B three-roll coach draft renders inside the arena shell; the old full-library modal is not used for Chaos Clash.

items.title: Matchup Console and Result Dock
items.fix: One dock with five states: pre-draft, active draft, Matchup Outlook, simulation and final result. Simulation shows named phases, never a fabricated percentage, and no state shows a win probability.

items.title: full postgame report
items.fix: The dock's four tabs give a fast summary; View Full Postgame Report expands the SAME stored result over the same page, and closing it returns to the same arena, teams, coaches, era and result.

items.title: result continuity
items.fix: After the game the drafted rosters, coaches and era remain on screen as a locked summary and no active roll control survives.
items.verification: Browser: 'The matchup you built' present, zero LOCK HOLDS controls.

items.title: new run clears stale result
items.fix: Starting a new Chaos Clash clears the dock to its pre-draft state, so an old score never sits beside an unrelated draft.
items.regressionTest: e2e/phase8c-arena.spec.js asserts no FINAL SCORE on a fresh board

items.title: mode shelf
items.fix: Generated from the same registry, with real access states, and a horizontal scroll shelf on mobile.

items.title: dark arena readability
items.leadingRootCause: The earlier dark interface failed because surfaces shared near-identical values and body copy was low contrast.
items.fix: Five measurably distinct panel elevations, near-white primary text and a secondary text token held above a contrast floor, all asserted by a gate rather than judged by eye.

items.title: approved imagery only
items.fix: The existing PlayerImage resolution is unchanged; no new likeness, photograph or logo was added.

items.title: keyboard navigation and focus
items.fix: Both menus open by keyboard, close on Escape and return focus to their trigger; the dock's result tabs are a real tablist.

items.title: reduced motion
items.fix: The court arc is removed and the roll reveal animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; no information depends on motion.

items.title: responsive behaviour
items.fix: Two columns at 1180px and above; the dock stacks below that. Verified at 375, 390, 430 and 768 with zero page-level horizontal overflow and 44px hold targets.

items.title: new destinations were reachable without the access gate
items.leadingRootCause: The preview middleware matcher covered only /, /api/*, /result/* and /challenge/*. Adding SPA rewrites for /membership, /fantasy/* and /modes/* would have served the whole app shell on those paths to an unauthenticated visitor.
alternatives: Use query-parameter views instead of paths — rejected: the brief's URL shape is what a future billing page must be able to adopt.
Rely on the rewrite target being gated — rejected: Vercel matches the middleware on the INCOMING path, not the rewritten one.
items.fix: All three paths were added to the matcher alongside the rewrites.
items.verification: Deployed: /membership, /fantasy/eraclash, /fantasy/live and /modes/era-gauntlet all return 401 without a key and 200 with one.
items.regressionTest: tests/v8c-arena-navigation.test.js asserts both the matcher and the rewrites

items.title: Era Gauntlet page rendered the wrong mode
items.leadingRootCause: The registry id was `gauntlet` while its information route was /modes/era-gauntlet. findMode missed, and the page fell back to PLAY_MODES[0] — rendering Chaos Clash while claiming to describe Era Gauntlet.
items.fix: findMode resolves by id OR info-route slug, and an unknown mode now says so rather than impersonating another.

items.title: primary CTA sat below a secondary button
items.leadingRootCause: The shell rendered RUN THE CLASH after ChaosClash, whose own ready block already carried a secondary action.
items.fix: The shell owns the primary CTA and suppresses the component's duplicate ready block at READY.

items.title: a chaos-disabled deployment showed a guest a dead end
items.leadingRootCause: Phase 8A put Dream Matchup behind an account gate. Where Chaos Clash is switched off — production's configuration — the app falls back to Dream Matchup, so a signed-out visitor met a gate with nothing else they could open. Caught by the production-flags-off e2e project.
alternatives: A crash in the builder — rejected: the page rendered the gate correctly, and React #31 disappeared once the gate stopped rendering.
A header regression — rejected: the header rendered and the API-only tests passed throughout.
items.fix: Dream Matchup asks for an account only while Chaos Clash is available as the free default. A follow-on temporal-dead-zone error from placing the derived flag after its use was fixed in the same pass.
items.verification: Flags-off harness: the manual builder renders for a guest, no gate, no console error.

items.title: preview access, scenarios and feedback
items.fix: Unchanged. Deployed access check 19/19 and scenario QA 21/21 on the Phase 8C preview.

items.title: production isolation
items.fix: main unchanged, wave1 alias untouched at Phase 8A, zero files changed under src/v3, still 12 API routes plus middleware.
